name: RegulatoryChangeTracker
tagline: From horizon scan to sign-off – every new law, rule and consultation assessed, actioned and implemented before it takes effect.
description: A complete regulatory change management app for in-house legal and compliance teams: a horizon scan by effective date, a change register across regulators and jurisdictions, a pipeline board from screening to implemented, impact assessments with applicability, impact rating and affected business units, action plans with owners and due dates, sign-off rules and a priority from impact and time to effect.
features: Horizon lanes by effective date (in effect, 30/90/180/365 days, later)
Action plans with owners, due dates and states
Status rules: owner, assessment, actions, approver and sign-off
Priority P1–P4 from impact × time to effect
Bulk owner, impact and status changes with undo
Phone layout with bottom view switcher
controlType: standard (RegulatoryChangeTracker data-set control + RegulatoryChangeTrackerPortal field control)
